content:
Erika Eleniak is taking back control of her life ― and her income ― thanks to an unexpected platform.

Eleniak, who played lifeguard Shauni McClain on the original “Baywatch” series, said she joined OnlyFans to help keep her house.

“I’m in this position where I’m not really acting anymore,” Eleniak said this week on an episode of the “Miss Understood” podcast. “You find yourself in that position where it’s like, I need to make a certain amount of money in order to pay my overhead. And so what do I do? Where am I going to make that kind of money?”

After being served an eviction notice, Eleniak joined the platform and was able to pay the rent just a few months later.

“The people that were in charge of my rental situation were really kind to me and really worked with me, so that was really a blessing,” the 57-year-old said.

She also made it clear that she isn’t nude on the platform.

“Mine is just fun and spicy everyday life stuff,” she said. “It’s what I do in my day, it’ll be, I’m out pumpkin shopping. It’ll be just whatever I’m doing at home ― making coffee.”

Through OnlyFans, Eleniak also says she was able to gauge the loyalty of her longtime fans.

“I’ve had a diverse career, and I’ve had a lot of people stay loyal and follow my career over the years,” she said. “So it was interesting to me to see if they were gonna jump on board with OnlyFans as well. And they have, which has been really nice.”

Eleniak isn’t the only Hollywood star to use OnlyFans as a way to assert control over their career. Elizabeth Shannon of “American Pie” expressed a similar sentiment earlier this year.

“I’ve spent my entire career working in Hollywood, where other people controlled the narrative and the outcome of my career,” she told People magazine in April, adding, “This new chapter is about changing that.”
